description: Golden evaluation dataset for the Personal AI Assistant agent. Each case specifies the natural-language user input, the expected tool selection, the expected (or minimum required) arguments, and the evaluation type it covers.

cases.input: Hey, how are you doing today? Tell me a fun fact about space.
cases.description: Ordinary chit-chat; the agent should respond without calling any tool.

cases.input: Create a task: finish the quarterly report, due on 2026-08-20, high priority.
cases.description: Should create a task with title, due date and priority.

cases.input: Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at 10am.
cases.description: Should create a task with an inferred title.

cases.input: What tasks do I have on my list right now?
cases.description: Should list existing tasks without arguments.

cases.input: What events do I have scheduled next Monday?
cases.description: Should query the calendar for the upcoming week.

cases.input: Schedule a meeting with the design team on 2026-08-25 from 14:00 to 15:00 titled Sprint Planning.
cases.description: Should create a calendar event with title and time range.

cases.input: Remember that I prefer to work in focused 90 minute blocks.

expected_args.content: prefers to work in focused 90 minute blocks

cases.description: Should persist a user preference to long-term memory.

cases.input: Do you remember how I like to work?
cases.description: Should retrieve a previously stored memory.

cases.input: According to the company handbook, what is the remote work policy?
cases.description: Should retrieve relevant knowledge base chunks.

cases.input: Find the onboarding guide section about expense reimbursement.
cases.description: Should retrieve the expense reimbursement documentation.
